description: This file defines the LogWrapper class which implements the LogNode interface. It acts as a wrapper around Android's native Log utility, forwarding log messages and chaining to the next LogNode if set.

classes.name: LogWrapper
classes.description: A helper class that wraps Android's native Log utility and implements the LogNode interface, enabling logging with chaining capability.

methods.name: getNext
methods.description: Returns the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: setNext
methods.description: Sets the next LogNode to forward logs to.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Logs the message using Android's Log.println and forwards the log to the next LogNode if available.
